paite: Huai zoh in Pharisaite leh Saddukaite ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in van a kipan chiamtehna amaute ensak ding in angen uhi.
heading: Chiamtehna Ngetna / (Mar 8.11-13; Luk 12.54-56)
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nitaklam ahong hih in, khua apha dia ahi ding e, meisan asuak a, na chi nak uh.
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

paite: Huan zingsang in, tuni'n khua se dia ahi ding e, meisan asuak a, aniamkai, na chi nak uh. 'Van omdan na theisiam ngal ua, himahleh, hun chiamtehnate na theisiam thei kei uhi.'
english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

paite: Khang gilou leh angkawmte'n chiamtehna azong ua, himahleh, Jonah chiamtehna lou ngal akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding," chi in adawng hi. Huan amaute paisan in apawtkheta hi.
english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

paite: Huan nungzuite gal khat lam atun un tanghou apo mangngilh ua,
heading: Pharisaite Leh Sadukaite Silngou / (Mar 8.14-21)
english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pharisaite leh Saddukaite silngou lak ah kiveng unla, pilvang un," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

paite: Amau, "Tanghou i puak louh ziak uh ei ve," chi in akingaihtuah uhi.
english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

paite: Jesu'n huai athei a, "Nou ginglahte aw, bang achia tanghou na neih louh ziak ua kingaihtuah maimah na hi ua?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

paite: Tu nangawn in na lungsim un na thei nai kei lailai uh maw? Mi sangnga nek tanghou phel nga leh akhamval uh bawmpi bangzah na dimsak zah uh na theigige kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

paite: Mi sangli nek tanghou phel sagih leh akhamval uh bawmpi bangzah hiam na luahdim uh chih thei lou uh maw?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

paite: Tanghou thu na kiang ua gen lou in, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite silngou a pan pilvang un, chih gen ka hi zaw chih bang achia thei lou na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

paite: Huaitak in tanghou silngou lak a pilvang ding in asawl kei a, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite thuhilhna a pan pilvang ding in amau asawl zaw chih atheita uhi.
english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

paite: Kaisaria uk a Philippi mun ahong tun in Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite'n Mihing Tapa kua ahi achi ua?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Hihna Aphuankhiakna / (Mar 8.27-30; Luk 9.18-21)
english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

paite: Amau, "Khenkhat in Baptispa Johan ahi, achi ua; khenkhat in Elijah; khenkhat in Jeremiah hiam zawlnei kuahiam ahi," achi uh, achi uhi.
english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

paite: Simon Peter in, "Khrist Pathian Hing Tapa na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, Bar Jonah, hampha chia; sa leh sisan in hon theihsak na hi kei a, ka Pa van a om hon theihsak na hi zaw hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, nang Peter na hi, hiai suangpi tung ah ka saptuam ka lamtou ding a, misi khokulh kongkhakte'n hiai azou kei ding uh.
english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

paite: Van lalgam chabite ka hon pe ding a, leitung ah bangpeuh na hen van ah leng hen ahi ding a, leitung ah bangpeuh na phel van ah leng phel ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

paite: Huai zoh in Khrist ahi chih kuamah hilh lou ding in nungzuite achi bikbek hi.
english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

paite: Huai nung in Jerusalem a apai ding dan, upate, siampu liante, laigelhmite a pan thil tampi athuakdan ding leh hihlup a a-omdan ding, ni thum ni a kaihthoh a a-omdan ding Jesu'n anungzuite atheisak panta hi.
heading: Jesu'n Asihna Leh Thohnawnna Ding Genkhol / (Mar 8.31-9.1; Luk 9.22-27)
english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

paite: Huai phet in Peter in amah apituam a, "Toupa, hi kei hen! Huaite na tung ah tung ngei kei hen!" chi in ataihilh hi.
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

paite: Jesu akihei a, Peter kiang ah, "Setan, ka nung ah pai in, kei a di'n pukna na hi; Pathian thilte ngaihtuah lou in mihing thilte na ngaihtuah zaw hi," achi hi.
english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

paite: Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuihnopleh amah kimangngilh in, ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
heading: Nungzuihna Man Piakna / (Mat 10.34-37; Mar 8.34-38; Luk 9.22-27)
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding a; kuapeuh keimah ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

paite: Mi'n khovel apumpi in nei henla, ahinna tanleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia? Ahihkeileh mi'n ahinna sik in bang ape thei dia?
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

paite: "Mihing Tapa a-angelte toh, a Pa thupina a kizem a ahong pai ding ziak in. Huai hun chiang in michih anasep bang un adin chiat ding hi.
english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon chi ahi, hiai adingh akhente, agam a Mihing Tapa hong pai amuh masiah uh, sihna chiam lou hial ding a-om uh," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”
